dataSource.fundFlow: Eastmoney individual fund-flow daykline where available
dataSource.limitation: Free Eastmoney fund-flow endpoint returned only recent rows during validation; earlier dates use real OHLC/turnover/amount/volume metrics with fund-flow fields left at 0. Historical intraday 14:55 prices are not available from the free daily dataset; late-session backtest uses daily close as the 14:55 price proxy.
